# Petiole & Bloom

> Petiole & Bloom LLC (https://petioleandbloom.com) is a US botanical nursery and cosmetic formulation lab propagating well-rooted rare tropical plants and formulating clinical-grade copper peptide (GHK-Cu) bio-active skincare.

## Primary Documentation
- [Full Knowledge Base & Product Guide](https://petioleandbloom.com/llms-full.txt): Complete technical documentation, botanical catalog, scientific formulation dossiers, and return/shipping specifications.
- [Storefront Catalog](https://petioleandbloom.com/shop): Full listing of available tropical nursery specimens and peptide serums.
- [Formulation Science & Research](https://petioleandbloom.com/science): Clinical research citations, PubMed references, active ingredient breakdowns, and skin barrier biology.
- [Plant Care & Acclimation Guide](https://petioleandbloom.com/care): Step-by-step unboxing, root care, watering, and mycorrhizal soil guidance.

## Core Products
- [Defy Peptide Face Serum](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/copper-peptide-serum-ghk-cu): 30 mL fragrance-free serum with GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1), 4–5% Niacinamide, Silk Peptides, and Licorice Root Extract (Glabridin) for collagen remodeling and barrier support.
- [Variegated Vanilla Orchid (Chartreuse)](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/variegated-vanilla-orchid-chartreuse): Uncommon chartreuse-variegated Vanilla planifolia climbing orchid established in 3" pot with Glomus mycorrhizae.
- [Vanilla Super Variegated Orchid](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/vanilla-super-variegated-orchid): Striking cream-and-green variegated Vanilla planifolia in 3" pot. Every plant uniquely patterned.
- [Musa Florida Variegated Banana](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/musa-florida-variegated-banana): Rare collector-grade variegated banana with bold white striping. Well-rooted in enriched soil.
- [Passion Fruit 2-Pack](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/passion-fruit-2-pack-panama-red-bounty): Panama Red & Bounty Passiflora edulis vines. Self-fertile, fast-flowering.
- [Banana Bunch 4-Pack](https://petioleandbloom.com/products/banana-bunch-4-unique-musa-plants): Curated collection of Truly Tiny, Popoulu, Dwarf Green, and Lakatan banana plants.

## Optional
- [Live Arrival Guarantee](https://petioleandbloom.com/care): Cold-weather heat packs included for orders of 2+ plants. 24-hour damage reporting for replacement or full refund.
